prompt: Write a #Requires statement that enforces PowerShell version 7.0 and requires the script to be run as administrator.
hints: #Requires uses -Version to specify the minimum version.
Each requirement can be on its own #Requires line.
explanation: The #Requires statement prevents the script from running unless the conditions are met. -Version 7.0 ensures PowerShell 7+ and -RunAsAdministrator requires an elevated session.

prompt: Write a comment-based help block with a .SYNOPSIS of 'Gets disk space report.' and a .PARAMETER section for a parameter called ComputerName described as 'The target computer.'
hints: Each keyword starts with a dot: .SYNOPSIS, .PARAMETER
The parameter name goes on the same line as .PARAMETER.

validation.hintOnFail: Set the synopsis to 'Gets disk space report.'
Add .PARAMETER ComputerName on the same line.
Describe the parameter as 'The target computer.'

solution:
<#
.SYNOPSIS
    Gets disk space report.

.PARAMETER ComputerName
    The target computer.
#>
explanation: Comment-based help uses special keywords preceded by a dot. Get-Help reads these blocks and displays them in the standard help format. The .PARAMETER keyword name must match an actual parameter.

prompt: Write a param() block with a mandatory string parameter called OutputPath and an optional integer parameter called MaxResults with a default value of 50.
hints: Use [Parameter(Mandatory)] to make a parameter required.
Type constraints go in square brackets: [string], [int].
Default values are assigned with = after the parameter name.

validation.hintOnFail: Use [Parameter(Mandatory)] to make the parameter required.
Set the default value of $MaxResults to 50.

explanation: The param() block defines script or function parameters. [Parameter(Mandatory)] makes OutputPath required. $MaxResults defaults to 50 if not provided by the caller.

prompt: Write the command to set the execution policy to RemoteSigned for the current user.
hints: RemoteSigned allows local scripts but requires downloaded scripts to be signed.

validation.hintOnFail: Use -Scope CurrentUser to apply it only to your user account.

explanation: Set-ExecutionPolicy controls which scripts are allowed to run. RemoteSigned is the recommended policy for most users. -Scope CurrentUser avoids needing administrator privileges.
